field_descriptions.account_id: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.
field_descriptions.billing_period: The time interval used to compute the invoice.
field_descriptions.broker: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.
field_descriptions.category: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.
field_descriptions.confirmation_number: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.
field_descriptions.customer: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.minimum_payment_due: The minimum payment required at this time.
field_descriptions.payment_due: The date that payment is due.
field_descriptions.payment_due_date: The date that payment is due.
field_descriptions.payment_method: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.
field_descriptions.payment_method_id: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).
field_descriptions.payment_status: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.
field_descriptions.provider: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.
field_descriptions.references_order: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.
field_descriptions.scheduled_payment_date: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.
